constructs.theoretical_construct: post popularity/visibility as signaled by score

features.name: post_score_above_50
features.definition: Is the observed original-post score greater than 50?
features.spec: pd.Series(np.where(pd.to_numeric(df['post_score'], errors='coerce').isna(), np.nan, (pd.to_numeric(df['post_score'], errors='coerce') > 50).astype(float))). 1 if post_score > 50 (strictly), 0 if <= 50, null if missing or non-numeric.

h0: post_score_above_50 has no association with the likelihood of view change (delta).
h1: Discussions with post_score_above_50 equal to 1 have a lower likelihood of view change than those with 0.
note: Threshold is strictly >50 as stated. post_score measurement time relative to the outcome is unknown and may reflect post-outcome popularity; post_created_utc does not establish timing. Association only, not causal. OLS on binary delta is a linear probability model.
